Inspired by “Dark Side of the Moon,” we tried to represent the intimate and personal emotions that came to us through the album. Each song has a language, each movement a color, each sound an expression. What remains today, half a century later? Something inexplicable, perhaps. A wonderful creation of friendship and mutual artistic esteem, the (re)creation of multiple memories, which overlap like membranes on the screen. - Erik Negro

1709982.trailerName: DEAR AJAYI I Official Trailer HD I 2o9ine

1711198.title: None Shall Escape
1711198.overview: In the war-torn Tan City, a female medical student ventures into the desolate and eerie ancestral mansion of the Yang family on the outskirts of the city to search for her twin sister. The mansion is empty and dilapidated. The strange-behaving landlady, the crazy landlord, and the elusive deaf-mute servant all make the place extremely eerie, sending shivers down her spine. Strange things happen frequently in the house. There are the eerie dolls that suddenly turn their heads, the terrifying nursery rhymes heard at night, the little girl who plays cat's cradle with herself in the shadows, and the long hair that quietly lands on her shoulder. Something seems to be calling her in the dark. She gradually realizes that her sister must have died here, and now she, who came in search of her blood relative, has become the landlady's next "prey" in the terrifying game.

1711390.title: Crossings : Kaleh Ziyarat
1711390.overview: Between the Caspian Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, through the reanimation of archives and documentary observation, a frenetic plunge into the parallel economies of a region shaped by imperial ambitions and survival instincts.

1712734.title: Autosave
1712734.overview: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

1713502.title: Glass Bricks
1713502.overview: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

1714206.title: Beneath the Blue Ice
1714206.overview: Tasha, a college student, finds herself caught between Layson, a devoted hockey player who loves her, and Aaron, who is only using her. As loyalties are tested on and off the ice, she has to decide who truly has her heart.

1714910.title: SOS: A Misstep that Changes Life
1714910.overview: A young trainee teacher begins his journey into the teaching profession with hopes and ideals. His convictions are put to the test when he finds himself caught in an emotional triangle involving a female student and a male LGBTQ+ student, both deeply devoted to him. As affection turns into an increasingly complicated bond, he must confront difficult choices between professional responsibility and personal emotions.
1714910.trailerName: Full Trailer for the film SOS: One Wrong Step, A Life Changed

1715934.title: Once Upon a Time In Gotham
1715934.overview: Something is going on in Gotham when the White Rabbit falls down the rabbit hole that is Gotham City. She encounters a series of unfortunate events and runs into the key players of the town. Finding herself face-to-face with infamous villains and comic book heroes.

1715998.title: Quantum Entangled
1715998.overview: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

1716510.title: Budaixi
1716510.overview: Wayang Potehi is a cultural heritage that has long been part of Indonesia's diversity, yet it remains little known in Surabaya. Through regular performances, preservation efforts, and the sharing of knowledge, dalang Sukar Mudjiono and fellow practitioners work to ensure this traditional art form survives for future generations.

1718366.title: Riakoi First Love
1718366.overview: Twenty-seven-year-old Sawako Okazaki works for an event-planning company and finds purpose in supporting her favorite idol, Kaisei Komaki. When her employer signs him and staff compete for the chance to manage his events, Sawako throws herself into the opportunity. Her admiration gradually becomes real love, but a woman claiming to be Kaisei’s girlfriend and harassment inside and outside the company shake her confidence. As Kaisei begins to trust her, he suddenly disappears. Sawako must overcome the setbacks and discover whether her devotion can become a genuine romance.

1719326.title: The Cheating Wife
1719326.overview: Two widows who find solace in each other and eventually fall in love. But when one of their supposedly dead husbands returns home blind, they are forced to hide their forbidden affair, testing the limits of love and loyalty.
1719326.trailerName: 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗖𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗪𝗜𝗙𝗘 Official Trailer | World Premiere this 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘 𝟮𝟲 only on VMX!

1719646.title: Gossip
1719646.overview: A soul-stirring tale of Ajanta, a girl next door with great aspirations to become a musician (Veena player) and hoping for a joyful future filled with abundant happiness. Unexpectedly, her life turns upside down, caused by an ugly gossip

1719774.title: Suitcased
1719774.overview: When a struggling student discovers his late father left him a locked pendrive containing a massive fortune in Bitcoin, he and his friends must crack a highly secure password with only one attempt remaining—unknowingly holding the key to a long-buried family secret.

1720286.title: Снежинка и снеговик
1720286.overview: Long-awaited snow falls in the village. A girl named Erica is building a large snowman with button eyes and a bright carrot. Grandma is preparing Snowflake's dress. The festivities of the New Year's carnival await, and the atmosphere around is filled with the holiday spirit, but gradually the quiet childish joy gives way to adult fear for the life of the snow giant—will the child be able to save him from destruction?

1723294.title: Soy Luna: Recap Seasons 1, 2 and 3
1723294.overview: Soy Luna tells the story of Luna Valente, a teenage girl who lives and dreams on roller skates. Over the course of three seasons, Luna and her friends embark on adventures, fall in love, sing and dance, and, above all, glide across the legendary Jam & Roller skating rink. Before the wheels start turning again… relive the best moments!

1724382.title: Major Bag Alert
1724382.overview: 2005. Gossip around the school is that 16-year-old Janina's family is having serious financial troubles. Janina and her group of friends plan to prove the rumours wrong by stealing an expensive handbag from the neighbourhood shopping centre.

1724958.title: เด็กตลาด Dream beneath The apron
directors: ศศิประภา ทองเย็น
cast: ศรัณย์พร เจริญราษฎร์
ณพล เสนางคนิกร

1725534.title: Plans
1725534.overview: Stopped at a traffic light in Maianga, Luanda, a man drifts into his inner world to the sound of ‘Planos’. Between reality and dream, he revisits youth, fears and lost hopes in a poetic journey blending memory, music and animation.

1726046.title: Bean
1726046.overview: Triggered by a baked bean on her best friend’s face, Meadhbh is forced to question their connection – and whether there’s anything left of it at all.

1726430.title: Super Subbu
1726430.overview: When Subbu takes a covert job teaching sex ed in rural Makhipur, his life flips upside down; to pursue his dreams, he must educate a resistant village without provoking his traditional father's wrath and balancing his romance.

1726750.title: Yayo
1726750.overview: Dana and Lydia are facing a serious trust issue in their relationship. After an argument that threatens to tear them apart, Lydia decides to accompany Dana to her grandfather’s house, where his wife has just passed away. There, the elderly man, driven by despair, becomes possessed by a demonic force and begins to hunt them down. Together, they must resolve their differences and learn to trust one another in order to survive.

1727134.title: Fit Check
1727134.overview: A man sees a mannequin dressed exactly like him.

1728158.title: Beyond The Threshold
1728158.overview: A novice filmmaker delves into an unresolved case from the past, unwittingly awakening ancestral forces that begin to transform her and those around her in dark ways
1728158.trailerName: Mas Allá del Umbral - Trailer (Beyond The Threshold, Trailer 1)

1728414.title: RESONANCIAs
1728414.overview: Deaf, withdrawn and isolated, a man spends his days running along the same rural road in preparation for a local race. After a serious injury, a magnetic resonance scan allows him to experience sound in an unexpected way through its noises and vibrations. The discovery encourages him to reconnect with the world he once left behind, but perhaps his place is no longer there.

1728862.title: Reaper Road
1728862.overview: Two friends end up on a never-ending road that leads into the woods, trapping them in a hellish dimension.

1729182.title: O'Slaughter Day
1729182.overview: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.
1729182.trailerName: SEATAPP | Kinodes üle Eesti 25. septembrist | Teaser trailer

1731486.title: What She Didn't Tell Me
1731486.overview: When a disturbing overdose rocks her new town, a determined but grieving pharmacist must unravel the link between a growing teen drug crisis and a mysterious grief website before her own daughter becomes the next target.

1735518.title: Soulbreaker Sword
1735518.overview: At the end of the Song Dynasty, the martial world is filled with bloodshed, with everyone fighting for the peerless Soulbreaker Sword. A charming disciple of Emei flees with the sword and runs into Mo Huicong, a disciple of Qingcheng. The divine sword is stolen, and a mystery about their origins suddenly unfolds. It turns out that the sword's original owner is his father, and the head of Emei's beauty trap hides a blood feud for the whole clan. In a desperate battle at the martial arts conference, Mo combines with the sword to take revenge. Finally, to end the chaos, he abandons the divine weapon and roams the world with his beloved.

1736478.title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
1736478.overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Padre Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

1736798.title: Nosotros
1736798.overview: Romero, a 23-year-old Indigenous man who used to drive a three-wheeled mototaxi (TucTuc) in his rural town, flees local gang extortion and migrates to Guatemala City. He finds a job as a security guard at a commercial center, where he falls in love with a trans woman who runs a local business. Together, they build an emotional sanctuary, but their bond is quickly threatened by the deep-seated prejudice and hostility of his coworkers.

1738014.title: Ādi
1738014.overview: "Ādi" (Sanskrit for "beginning" or "origin) captures the origin of the cross-cultural musical group Vishnu, Davis, & Haleigh as they discover new friendships and new sounds together.

1738590.title: Next Step
1738590.overview: Trista and Ellis are a young couple, but their relationship is tested when Trista is suffering from an illness that changes her daily life. Ellis refuses to let her face it alone.

1738718.title: Благоустройство
1738718.overview: A hot summer is in full swing. A bronze Pushkin has taken up residence in the city of N. Garbage truck driver Pyotr drives along familiar routes, emptying sun-baked bins. Everyone waits for rain, but only furious thunder rumbles on the sultry evenings, doing nothing to cool the hot Earth. Only the splash of a small fountain offers relief from the stifling boredom. A wedding is in preparation. Pyotr is planning to marry off his only son, a cold and stern figure who is steadfast in his love for his parents. At night, the fountain retires, leaving only Pushkin's bronze shoulder, a place to cool a head weary from the day...

1738846.title: Summer '16
1738846.overview: Set during the summer of 2016, Jared's world shifts when his best friend, Bando, lands his first job—forcing Jared to confront the one thing he's been avoiding: growing up.

1739294.title: Maaran
1739294.overview: In a patriarchal society, two strangers - Birwa, a trafficking survivor, and Tara, who faces the same fate - are drawn into the path of a ruthless predator. Maaran exposes the devastating impact of gender-based violence and oppression.

1740190.title: Cheesecake
1740190.overview: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

1752414.title: About the Soufflé
1752414.overview: When Connor is unexpectedly told he needs to find another place to stay, he's thrust into the streets of Darwin with no safety net. A chance encounter with a local band of creatives leads him on a journey of growth and self-discovery as he battles to overcome personal traumas. Set against the unique backdrop of Australia's Top End, this experimental independent feature is both an intimate character study and a heartfelt love letter to Darwin - the city that inspired the filmmakers who call it home.

1754654.title: Vera
1754654.overview: A pregnant woman flees a violent past and takes refuge on the coast of Santa Fe, where she struggles to overcome the challenges of nature and existence itself.

1755486.title: NJPW Destruction In Kobe 2026
1755486.overview: NJPW Destruction In Kobe 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 27, 2026, at Kobe World Hall in Kobe, Hyogo, Japan. The show was headlined by Yota Tsuji (c) vs. Hirooki Goto for the IWGP World Heavyweight Title.

1755614.title: Night Adrift
1755614.overview: When a wild hen night spirals out of control, a Deaf bride-to-be’s bond with beloved hearing friends over the course of her life is about to shatter. Can she endure her friendship or face a truth she’s long tried to silence?

1756190.title: Meurtres à Fontainebleau
1756190.overview: When a murder revives the legend of the "Grand Veneur", the forest of Fontainebleau becomes the hunting ground of an elusive killer.

1756766.title: Maricones
1756766.overview: Since they were little, Ginger and Louie knew they were different. Two young Queers who, living in different spaces, face social prejudices that try to limit their way of being. This tension confronts them with their identity process and leads them to question the need for external validation. Thus, they decide to use fashion and their bodies as a tool to express and build their identity as a process of constant fluidity, free and without labels.

1757470.title: Shadow Realm
1757470.overview: While Detectives Eisler and Komlatschek fear for Oberländer's life, they uncover a bloody trail of revenge that leads them to an abandoned juvenile home deep in the woods.
1757470.trailerName: Murder by the Lake – Into the Shadow Realm

1757854.title: Paquet de troubles
1757854.overview: Karim, a passionate teenager with a promising future as a musician, learns he has schizophrenia. Devastated by this news, and surrounded by his mother and sister, he tries to rediscover his identity, even putting himself in danger.

1760094.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 7
1760094.overview: The seventh night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 17, 2026, at Asahikawa City General Gymnasium in Asahikawa, Hokkaido, Japan.

1764510.title: Waterloo
1764510.overview: A space alien, sent to Earth to bring back rock 'n' roll, and her human manager struggle to book a music gig and prove that rock isn't dead.

1771806.title: A Puppets Debt
1771806.overview: A mafia worker slowly loses himself, but is it too late?
